sources.title: Beyond empirical models: Discovering new constitutive laws in solids with graph-based equation discovery

required_steps: Freeze benchmark statement/data/code hashes and pin proof-assistant/kernel/library versions.
Reject unapproved axioms and proof placeholders; archive imports and exact formal statement.
Compare deterministic evaluator, symbolic regression, LLM-guided search, and proof-feedback arms under matched total resource budgets.
Record held-out error, counterexamples, proof validity, false discoveries, wall time, tokens, host compute, energy where measurable, and total cost including failures.
For physical candidates, require a predeclared discriminating experiment and independent replication after all mathematical gates.
next_gate.acceptance_rule: A checked proof validates only the frozen formal statement under its explicit assumptions. No automatic promotion to a physical law or technology claim.

mission_effects.INV-029: No Data-Center-to-Phone closure; only a proposed correctness-verification method.
mission_effects.INV-030: Method-level constitutive discovery can guide candidate screening; no Pangola-derived critical-material substitution or elemental transmutation.
mission_effects.INV-031: No saleable bio-oil yield or full-cost result.
mission_effects.INV-032: No net reliable fusion-electricity or lifecycle-cost result.
mission_effects.INV-033: No measured principal, interest, WACC, or time-to-evidence effect.
mission_effects.INV-034: Supports mathematics-first hypothesis/proof workflow without changing physical limits.
mission_effects.INV-035: Adds a possible formal verifier while retaining dimensional, symmetry, conservation, causality, held-out, falsification, experiment, replication, and economics gates.
